description: Web scraping, crawling, search, and agentic extraction — the full Firecrawl v2 API, on your own Firecrawl account.

product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When you need content from the live web: read a page as clean markdown, search the web, enumerate a site's URLs, crawl a whole domain, or extract structured data from pages.

quickstart.goal: Get your own Firecrawl account — run this once, before anything else
quickstart.note: Calling this accepts Firecrawl's Terms of Service (https://www.firecrawl.dev/terms-of-service); the acceptance is recorded against your Pilot identity. Your key is cached locally and injected on every later call — you never handle it.

examples.title: Read any page as clean markdown
examples.expect: {"success":true,"data":{"markdown":"# Example Domain\n\nThis domain is for use in documentation examples...","metadata":{"creditsUsed":1}}}

examples.title: Search the web and get real content back
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.firecrawl firecrawl.search '{"query":"open source web crawlers","limit":3}'

examples.title: Enumerate a site's URLs before paying to crawl it
examples.note: Always map before a crawl: crawl bills per page and defaults to 10000.

examples.title: Crawl a site — async, returns a job id
examples.note: SET limit — it defaults to 10000 pages.

examples.title: Check what you have left (free read)

cost.free_budget: 10,000 credits on your own Firecrawl account, valid 3 months

operations.note: once per identity; mints your key and grants the 10,000 credits
bills as it runs — always set limit

cost.worked_total: This demo spends about 14 of your 10,000 credits (scrape 1 + search 2 + map 1 + a 10-page crawl 10; signup and both reads are free).

gotchas: Run firecrawl.signup once first — every other method soft-fails with needs_signup until you do.
Signup accepts Firecrawl's terms (https://www.firecrawl.dev/terms-of-service) and is recorded against your Pilot identity.
Your account is your own: your own credits, your own rate and concurrency limits, your own jobs.
crawl bills per page and defaults to limit 10000; agent defaults to maxCredits 2500. Set both.
Async methods return a job id — poll the matching *_status.
Your starting credits expire 3 months after signup and are granted once per identity.
